purpose: Name shared actor-template records used by presentation-response and interaction spawns.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_8B_PRESENTATION_RESPONSE
templates.post_spawn: Each path may replace the animation root with an event-specific stream and conditionally queues the interaction audio.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_1A_PRESENTATION_BASE
templates.post_spawn: The three callers publish runtime types 0x1A, 0x1B, and 0x1C respectively, with branch-specific facing and position adjustments.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_53_INTERACTION
templates.post_spawn: Adds 0x18 to actor X and subtracts 0x0E from actor Y.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_17_INTERACTION
templates.post_spawn: Uploads palette source 0x001292B2 when the presentation gate at 0x00FFF175 is clear.

conclusion: All four records are selected by complete direct spawn bodies and their post-spawn behavior is bounded by the exported instruction stream. No neighboring record is promoted by association alone.
